    static Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    static Map<Integer, State> stateMap = new HashMap<>();

    static class State {
        int depth;
        long ways;

        State(int d, long w) {
            depth = d;
            ways = w;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            else b++;

        stateMap.put(startState, new State(0, 1));

        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            bfs(queue.poll());
        }

        if (stateMap.containsKey(0)) {
            State finalState = stateMap.get(0);
            System.out.println(finalState.depth + "\n" + finalState.ways);
        } else {
            System.out.println("-1\n0");
        }
    }

    static void bfs(int state) {
        int boat = state / 1000000;
        int currA = (state % 1000000) / 100;
        int currB = state % 100;

        if (boat == 1) {
            for (int takeA = currA; takeA >= 0 && 50 * (currA - takeA) <= k; takeA--) {
                for (int takeB = currB; takeB >= 0 && 50 * (currA - takeA) + 100 * (currB - takeB) <= k; takeB--) {
                    if (takeA != currA || takeB != currB) {
                        long ways = (choose[currA][takeA] * choose[currB][takeB]) % MOD;
                        updateState(takeA, takeB, 0, state, ways);
                    }
                }
            }

                for (int takeB = currB; takeB <= b && 50 * (takeA - currA) + 100 * (takeB - currB) <= k; takeB++) {
                    if (takeA != currA || takeB != currB) {
                        long ways = (choose[a - currA][takeA - currA] * choose[b - currB][takeB - currB]) % MOD;
                        updateState(takeA, takeB, 1, state, ways);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void updateState(int newA, int newB, int newBoat, int oldState, long edgeWays) {
        int newState = encodeState(newBoat, newA, newB);
        int newDepth = stateMap.get(oldState).depth + 1;

        if (!stateMap.containsKey(newState)) {
            stateMap.put(newState, new State(newDepth, 0));
            queue.offer(newState);
        }

        if (stateMap.get(newState).depth == newDepth) {
            long currentWays = stateMap.get(newState).ways;
            long updatedWays = (currentWays + (stateMap.get(oldState).ways * edgeWays) % MOD) % MOD;
            stateMap.get(newState).ways = updatedWays;
        }
    }

    static void precomputeBinomialCoefficients() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            choose[i][0] = 1;

            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {

            }

    }

    static int encodeState(int boat, int aCount, int bCount) {
        return 1000000 * boat + 100 * aCount + bCount;
